title: So cheap
text: So cheap. Terrible! These things are so cheap looking. Most of them came bent. I had to use them because of my Christmas theme, however, I’m going to search for some better ones so I can replace them.

product_metadata.title: 15PCS Christmas Tree Decorations Ornaments Large Size - 8.7Inches Poinsettia Flowers Artificial Glitter Xmas Ornaments with Clips (Blue)
features: Package includes 15 Christmas glitter poinsettia flowers + 15 clips +15 plastic stakes.The glitter may shed off when it comes.Just shake off the glitter.That would not affect exterior looking.

With clips and stakes - The glitter poinsettia flowers are approximate 8.7"diameter.The set come with clips and plastic stakes .You can easily attach them to Christmas tree,Christmas wreath or garlands and help to give it a real pop of brightness evenly distributed.
Material - Handmade.They are made of durable fabric cloth and plastic.
Suitable for mantle decorations,Christmas wreath,rattan,wedding decorations,room decorations,Christmas tree decorations,crafting project,holiday floral arrangements and vase.

Easy to assemble.Just insert the clip tip or stake into the Christmas flower base tube,then decorate anywhere you would like. It might have smell when you open the package.Just air it out for 1-2 days. The smell would go away.
